title: Global Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as University of São Paulo, UNICAMP and UNESP. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking a proactive, results-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our global HR team. In this role, you will drive the hiring of top-tier talent across Europe and APAC, and help us build high-performing teams in both technical and business functions. You will own the end-to-end recruitment process, build and nurture strong talent pipelines, and deliver a fast, high-quality hiring experience that directly contributes to our company’s growth and success worldwide.


Responsibilities:


  • Execute targeted hiring strategies to identify, and hire high-quality talent across sales, technical, and business roles.
  • Proactively source candidates using diverse channels, including job boards, social media, professional networks, referrals, and direct outreach.
  • Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline to support rapid hiring and future growth.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, skill needs, and success profiles.
  • Track and report key recruiting metrics (time-to-hire, pipeline quality, candidate conversion rates) to support continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a brand ambassador, ensuring candidates clearly understand the company’s mission, values, and employee experience.
  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle—sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordinating assessments, and facilitating selection decisions.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS).


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably in software or technology companies.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Experience supporting global recruitment, ideally across Europe and APAC.
  • Proficiency with recruiting and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and other platforms.
  • Ability to adapt quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ambitious, results-driven, and thrives in high-growth settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and candidate experience skills.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation package competitively placed within the local market
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Global Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as University of São Paulo, UNICAMP and UNESP. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking a proactive, results-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our global HR team. In this role, you will drive the hiring of top-tier talent across Europe and APAC, and help us build high-performing teams in both technical and business functions. You will own the end-to-end recruitment process, build and nurture strong talent pipelines, and deliver a fast, high-quality hiring experience that directly contributes to our company’s growth and success worldwide.


Responsibilities:


  • Execute targeted hiring strategies to identify, and hire high-quality talent across sales, technical, and business roles.
  • Proactively source candidates using diverse channels, including job boards, social media, professional networks, referrals, and direct outreach.
  • Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline to support rapid hiring and future growth.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, skill needs, and success profiles.
  • Track and report key recruiting metrics (time-to-hire, pipeline quality, candidate conversion rates) to support continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a brand ambassador, ensuring candidates clearly understand the company’s mission, values, and employee experience.
  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle—sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordinating assessments, and facilitating selection decisions.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS).


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably in software or technology companies.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Experience supporting global recruitment, ideally across Europe and APAC.
  • Proficiency with recruiting and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and other platforms.
  • Ability to adapt quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ambitious, results-driven, and thrives in high-growth settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and candidate experience skills.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation package competitively placed within the local market
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: SRE - brazil
description:
Decskill, founded in 2014 as an IT Consulting Company, places paramount importance on its greatest asset: its people. Our main mission is to deliver value through knowledge and talent, and we achieve this by fostering a culture of excellence and investing in the development and well-being of our people. With over 600 dedicated professionals and offices in Lisbon, Porto, Madrid, and Luxembourg, Decskill operates across three core areas:


  • Decskill Talent: We believe that our people are key to our success. Through Decskill Talent, we empower our team to embrace the digital transformation challenges of our clients. We collaborate with clients to drive innovation, ensuring project success and business growth.


  • Decskill Boost: Equipping our team with the latest tools and methodologies, we optimize Time-to-Market and deliver innovative solutions exceeding client expectations.


  • Decskill Connect: Our team collaborates closely with clients to implement and manage IT infrastructures that generate long-term value.


At Decskill, we believe that by nurturing and empowering our people to confront the challenges of digital transformation, we create value not only for our clients but also for our entire ecosystem, fostering a digital community dedicated to growth and progress.


We are looking for an SRE to join us on a remote project in Brasil.


Responsabilities:

  • Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders, developers, and managers to ensure timely deliverables.
  • Maximize the capabilities of our Azure platform for business applications.
  • Continuously evolve and enhance our identity management systems.
  • Prioritize the observability of our Azure environments.
  • Maintain cost efficiency and FinOps control of the platform.
  • Implement SRE and DevOps practices with a focus on Infrastructure as Code, automation, and scalability.
  • Design, develop, and implement new features to foster a CI/CD mindset, optimizing the software development lifecycle from development to production.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex incidents, ensuring they do not recur.
  • Implement code review and testing mechanisms to continuously improve quality.
  • Ensure robust security practices are integrated into all aspects of the infrastructure and identity management systems.
  • Build and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure on Azure.
  • Apply best practices for security, compliance, and operational efficiency across all systems.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Azure and its ecosystem in a production environment.
  • Familiarity with identity management technologies, particularly Azure Active Directory and EntraID.
  • Solid understanding of observability best practices, particularly in Azure environments.
  • Proficiency in using code management tools and repositories.
  • Experience with public cloud platforms.
  • Expertise in Infrastructure as Code, particularly with Terraform.
  • Strong autonomy and critical thinking skills, with a focus on collaboration.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills (written, listening, and speaking), a collaborative mindset, and a proactive attitude.
  • Fluency in English (mandatory).


Additional/Preferable Skills

  • Proficiency in using GitLab and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Strong knowledge of observability stacks, including monitoring, logging, and tracing.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies.
  • Experience with security frameworks and best practices in cloud environments.
  • Certified Azure Administrator (AZ-104) certification.


If you’re interested in this job please send your CV in English to with reference DA/SRE


Decskill is committed to equality and non-discrimination with all our talents. We recruit and promote talent, based on diversity and inclusion, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, race, nationality or any other form of discrimination incompatible with the dignity of the human being.

title: Mulesoft Solution Architect - 127594
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional Especialista para atuar com Arquitetura de Soluções Mulesoft em um projeto internacional.

Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), configurar VPNs e estabelecer conectividade segura entre ambientes locais e na nuvem.
  • Configurar Transit Gateway para simplificar a arquitetura de rede e melhorar a escalabilidade

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Inglês avançado / fluente;
  • Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto de Integração, com histórico de projetos bem-sucedidos;
  • Conhecimento profundo em arquiteturas de integração, incluindo API, SOA, ETL, Mensageria, Eventos etc;
  • Experiência com a metodologia C4E Mulesoft , preferencialmente tendo participado de sua implantação ou ao menos ter trabalhado com ela;
  • Experiência prática com tecnologias de integração, como MuleSoft, Api Manager, java sprintboot, entre outras;
  • Sólido conhecimento em design de APIs, padrões de integração e desenvolvimento de serviços;
  • Proficiência em Anypoint Studio e em componentes da plataforma MuleSoft (Design Center, Exhange, API manager, APi Governace, Runime manager, Monitoring);
  • Domínio do padrão API Led;
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas empresariais e conhecimento prático de arquiteturas de nuvem;
  • Experiência comprovada em arquitetura de infraestrutura na plataforma CloudHub;
  • Conhecimento sólido em redes, segurança de dados e práticas de gerenciamento de identidade na nuvem.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Consultor Comercial – Agência de Comunicação Visual

Estamos em busca de um Consultor Comercial para integrar nosso time e atuar diretamente na prospecção, relacionamento e fechamento de novos clientes. Se você é uma pessoa comunicativa, organizada e movida por resultados, esta vaga é para você.

Sobre a Agência

Somos uma agência especializada em comunicação visual digital, oferecendo serviços como identidade visual, criação de artes, encartes, branding e materiais institucionais. Nosso foco é ajudar empresas a profissionalizarem sua presença visual e fortalecerem suas marcas.

Responsabilidades

title: Gerente de projetos
description:
Elaborar o plano de projeto (escopo, cronograma, orçamento, riscos, qualidade e recursos).

Definir a metodologia e as ferramentas a serem utilizadas (ágil, tradicional ou híbrida).

Identificar e mapear stakeholders internos e externos.

Garantir a entrega de marcos e produtos do projeto dentro do prazo, custo e escopo acordados.

Estabelecer e manter uma comunicação clara e constante com clientes e áreas envolvidas.

Gerenciar expectativas e garantir o alinhamento entre os objetivos do projeto e os interesses dos stakeholders.

Liderar equipes multidisciplinares, promovendo o engajamento e alinhamento contínuo.

Identificar, analisar e mitigar riscos durante todo o ciclo de vida do projeto.

Resolver conflitos, atuar de forma proativa em desvios e propor soluções rápidas e eficazes.

Garantir a documentação adequada do projeto, seguindo os padrões do grupo.

Contribuir para a evolução da maturidade em gestão de projetos da organização.

Domínio em ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos ( MS Project, Jira)

Conhecimento em gestão de riscos, escopo, cronograma, custos, stakeholders e qualidade.

Conhecimento em metodologia cascata.

title: Desenvolvedor Progress Sr (PJ)
description:
A QualiIT é uma empresa de tecnologia voltada para soluções nos principais ERP’s do mercado. Prestamos serviços de implantação, consultoria, desenvolvimento, alocação de profissionais, focando no resultado e processos de nossos clientes.


Aqui, acreditamos que inovação nasce da parceria entre talentos e propósito.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, desafios e aprendizado constante, vem crescer com a gente!


Faça parte de uma empresa que conecta pessoas e tecnologia para gerar resultados reais!


Confira abaixo a vaga disponível e venha fazer parte dessa história.


Responsabilidades


  • Realizar desenvolvimento no ambiente Progress (TOTVS) – UPC, API, EPC e DDK;
  • Executar análise de requisitos junto às áreas de negócio;
  • Contribuir com a melhoria contínua dos sistemas e processos;
  • Apoiar o time na identificação e solução de incidentes e demandas técnicas.


Requisitos


  • Superior completo: Sistemas da Informação, Tecnologia e Administração;
  • Forte vivência na área de desenvolvimento;
  • Imprescindível experiência com Progress / TOTVS - Data Sul;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em ambientes complexos e multifuncionais;
  • Excelente relacionamento interpessoal com equipe técnica e áreas usuárias.
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e orientado a resultados.

title: Analista de Service Desk (Inglês Avançado) - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Analista de Service Desk (Inglês Avançado) - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você :

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

  • Atuará como Analista de Suporte no Service Desk para atendimento de clientes globais em inglês no modelo Follow The Sun (FTS).
  • Escala 12x36 (9h as 21h).


O que esperamos de você:

Indispensável:

  • Experiência prévia em Service Desk / Suporte Técnico N1.
  • Conhecimento em: Windows 10/11, contas de usuário, permissões e troubleshooting básico, Active Directory (reset de senha, desbloqueio, grupos).
  • Pacote Office / M365 (Ex: Configuração de Outlook e etc).
  • VPN, redes básicas e conectividade.
  • Hardware e periféricos.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de ticket (preferencialmente ServiceNow).
  • Inglês avançado (comunicação com equipes globais).


Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com ambiente global 24x7 / FTS.
  • Conhecimento em ITIL Foundation.
  • Experiência em suporte a múltiplos clientes (MSP).
  • Espanhol Intermediário


Formação Obrigatória:

Cursando Graduação na área de TI, Graduado ou Ensino Médio Técnico (TI) completo.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo.Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Mobile III (PLENO)
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Salesforce Developer with Vlocity (Inglês Avançado)
description:
Responsibilities:

· Lead and own the full software development life cycle (SDLC) of Salesforce projects, including requirement analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and support.

· Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

· Design and implement customized solutions on the Salesforce platform using Apex, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Visualforce, SOAP/Rest APIs, and declarative tools.

· Focus on Salesforce Vlocity development with an emphasis on Enterprise Product Catalog (EPC)/CPQ, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), OmniScripts, DataRaptors, and Integration Procedures (IPs).

· Manage offshore team and support existing Salesforce applications, including troubleshooting, bug fixing, and performance tuning.

· Provide technical leadership to junior developers, including planning, assigning, and reviewing their tasks, to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.

· Collaborate with business stakeholders to prioritize tickets based on urgency, impact, and business value.

· Estimate effort and timelines for user stories and tasks to support effective sprint planning.

· Plan and create sprints, ensuring a balanced workload and alignment with project timelines and objectives.

· Assign tasks to team members based on skillsets, availability, and delivery priorities.

· Conduct daily stand-up meetings to track progress, gather updates, and identify and resolve blockers.

· Coordinate cross-functionally to ensure timely resolution of dependencies and issues impacting delivery.

· Liaise with the testing team to review test scenarios and support test planning activities.


Qualifications:

· Proven experience leading Salesforce projects through the full SDLC.

· Expertise in Apex, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Visualforce, SOAP/REST APIs, and Salesforce declarative tools.

· Strong background in Salesforce Vlocity development, particularly with EPC/CPQ, CLM, OmniScripts, DataRaptors, and IPs.

· Experience managing offshore teams and supporting existing Salesforce applications.

· Ability to provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers.

· Proficient in performing code reviews and handling deployments using GitHub and Jenkins.

· Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

· Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

· Proactive approach to stay informed about platform enhancements and release updates.

· Experience in coordinating with business stakeholders to prioritize work, plan sprints, and ensure smooth project delivery.

If you are a seasoned Salesforce professional with a passion for leading projects and delivering exceptional solutions, we encourage you to apply and join our innovative team.



We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) de Chatbot Pleno
description:
Nós da Neppo , empresa do Grupo Sankhya , temos uma grande oportunidade para você, que quer atuar no mercado de TI como Desenvolvedor(a) de Chatbot Pleno , tendo como missão desenvolver e evoluir chatbots inteligentes e integrações eficientes, garantindo uma experiência conversacional de qualidade para o usuário, com foco em performance, usabilidade.


Atuando desde 2009 em Uberlândia (MG) , na Neppo somos antenados, ligados em tecnologia e em relacionamentos próximos e duradouros entre pessoas e empresas. Vivemos e respiramos criatividade e colaboração, por isso estamos sempre abertos a novos modelos de negócios e parcerias. Trabalhamos sob as premissas de liberdade, criatividade, transparência, comprometimento e inovação tecnológica.


Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho leve, em que nosso time tenha autonomia e flexibilidade. Nossos Neppers e parceiros são o que temos de mais valioso, por isso, estamos sempre pensando em como tornar a Neppo um lugar melhor para nosso time. Buscamos pessoas com iniciativa, sede de conhecimento, dedicação e vontade de crescer!


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de bots e fluxos de integração, garantindo qualidade e desempenho.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações robustas para projetos voltados a clientes.
  • Integrar o front-end com APIs, garantindo comunicação eficiente e segura.
  • Colaborar com PO, analistas de requisitos e outros stakeholders para atender às demandas de projetos.
  • Atender chamados para manutenção/sustentação do código.
  • Escrever código limpo, testável e bem documentado, seguindo as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de desenvolvimento, contribuindo para code reviews e boas práticas de programação.
  • Documentar processos e soluções de forma clara e detalhada.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação completa ou cursando em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência com JavaScript e Java.
  • Integrações: Experiência com APIs REST/RESTful e serviços externos.
  • Chatbots & IA: Experiência no desenvolvimento de fluxos de chatbots, prompt engineering, e tecnologias de IA/NLP (Natural Language Processing).
  • Versionamento & DevOps: Experiência com Git e práticas de CI/CD .
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (MariaDB, Oracle ). nível básico
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Vivência em Scrum, Kanban e uso de ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Trello, Azure DevOps). nível básico.
  • Arquitetura: Familiaridade com princípios de arquitetura de software e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Seria legal se você tivesse


  • Experiência com Banco de Dados MySQL .


Localidade | Atuação


Uberlândia/MG: Híbrido

Demais localidades: Remoto


Informações adicionais


Na Neppo , prezamos muito pelo equilíbrio entre o lado profissional e pessoal. Sabemos que hoje tudo é interligado e, no fim das contas, é tudo sobre gente . Por isso, nossos benefícios são personalizados para Neppers , confira:


⏱Horários Flexíveis

Nós da Neppo , empresa do Grupo Sankhya , temos uma grande oportunidade para você, que quer atuar no mercado de TI como Desenvolvedor(a) de Chatbot Pleno , tendo como missão desenvolver e evoluir chatbots inteligentes e integrações eficientes, garantindo uma experiência conversacional de qualidade para o usuário, com foco em performance, usabilidade.


Atuando desde 2009 em Uberlândia (MG) , na Neppo somos antenados, ligados em tecnologia e em relacionamentos próximos e duradouros entre pessoas e empresas. Vivemos e respiramos criatividade e colaboração, por isso estamos sempre abertos a novos modelos de negócios e parcerias. Trabalhamos sob as premissas de liberdade, criatividade, transparência, comprometimento e inovação tecnológica.


Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho leve, em que nosso time tenha autonomia e flexibilidade. Nossos Neppers e parceiros são o que temos de mais valioso, por isso, estamos sempre pensando em como tornar a Neppo um lugar melhor para nosso time. Buscamos pessoas com iniciativa, sede de conhecimento, dedicação e vontade de crescer!


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de bots e fluxos de integração, garantindo qualidade e desempenho.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações robustas para projetos voltados a clientes.
  • Integrar o front-end com APIs, garantindo comunicação eficiente e segura.
  • Colaborar com PO, analistas de requisitos e outros stakeholders para atender às demandas de projetos.
  • Atender chamados para manutenção/sustentação do código.
  • Escrever código limpo, testável e bem documentado, seguindo as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de desenvolvimento, contribuindo para code reviews e boas práticas de programação.
  • Documentar processos e soluções de forma clara e detalhada.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação completa ou cursando em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência com JavaScript e Java.
  • Integrações: Experiência com APIs REST/RESTful e serviços externos.
  • Chatbots & IA: Experiência no desenvolvimento de fluxos de chatbots, prompt engineering, e tecnologias de IA/NLP (Natural Language Processing).
  • Versionamento & DevOps: Experiência com Git e práticas de CI/CD .
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (MariaDB, Oracle ). nível básico
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Vivência em Scrum, Kanban e uso de ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Trello, Azure DevOps). nível básico.
  • Arquitetura: Familiaridade com princípios de arquitetura de software e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Seria legal se você tivesse


  • Experiência com Banco de Dados MySQL .


Localidade | Atuação


Uberlândia/MG: Híbrido

Demais localidades: Remoto


Informações adicionais


Na Neppo , prezamos muito pelo equilíbrio entre o lado profissional e pessoal. Sabemos que hoje tudo é interligado e, no fim das contas, é tudo sobre gente . Por isso, nossos benefícios são personalizados para Neppers , confira:


⏱Horários Flexíveis

title: Vendedor
description:
Estamos em busca de profissionais de vendas que possuam ambição financeira!


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:


  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Habilidade com vendas;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação;
  • Possuir computador com Webcam e acesso a internet;
  • Possuir telefone celular para realizar ligações e trocar mensagens de WhatsApp;


SOBRE A VAGA:


  • Modelo PJ;
  • Home Office;
  • 40 horas de dedicação semanal;
  • Reuniões diárias com o time e gestor;
  • Prospecção ativa (Instagram, LinkedIn, Google, Networking pessoal, etc);
  • Não daremos leads para serem trabalhados;


REMUNERAÇÃO:


Salário fixo inicial: R$ 1.500, podendo chegar a R$ 2.500 de fixo com base no plano de carreira;

Comissão: variável de 1% a 2% conforme produção mensal;


PROJEÇÃO DE REMUNERAÇÃO (MÍNIMO - 5 vendas/mês, ticket médio atual)


  • Mês 1: R$ 2.000 mensal
  • Mês 6: R$ 5.000 mensal
  • Mês 12: R$ 7.500 mensal


PROJEÇÃO DE REMUNERAÇÃO (META - 10 vendas/mês, ticket médio atual)


  • Mês 1: R$ 2.700 mensal
  • Mês 6: R$ 9.200 mensal
  • Mês 12: R$ 14.500 mensal

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Solution Architecture who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

English fluently

Solution Architect, Azure cloud, Integration patterns REST API,

Proficiency in areas such as solution architecture, software development, databases (SQL and NoSQL), microservices, APIs, and cloud-native architectures.


Knowledge of agile methodologies and project management frameworks.


Designing the architecture of complex systems, ensuring they are scalable, resilient, and optimized in terms of cost and performance.

Azure , API

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Title: Cloud Engineer

Location: Remote / Hybrid (BRAZIL)

Experience Level: Mid–Senior

Duration: Long-term Contract


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and support solutions on GCP and AWS
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts using Python
  • Lead or support workflow migration initiatives to cloud-native architectures
  • Work with AVID MAM for media workflow integration and automation
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot cloud applications, media workflows, and infrastructure


Required Skills:

  • Strong hands-on expertise in GCP and AWS
  • Proficiency in Python for automation and workflow integration
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI)
  • AVID MAM experience is mandatory
  • Ability to troubleshoot, optimize, and document cloud and media workflows


Nice to Have:

  • Media workflows or broadcast systems experience
  • Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Familiarity with storage, CDN, streaming, or metadata management in cloud environments


If you’re interested in this opportunity, please share your updated resume to or reach me on WhatsApp at .

title: Auxiliar de Loja - Shopping Campo Grande | Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência
description:
Esta é uma posição afirmativa para Inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência na Natura – parte do nosso Compromisso Com a Vida e com a nossa sociedade. Caso você não se autodeclare como parte desse grupo, recomendamos que dê uma olhada nas nossas outras posições. Para nós, diversidade, equidade e inclusão são dimensões do mesmo esforço para transformar o mundo e nos transformar; para ter equipes que sejam reflexo das realidades dos países onde operamos e nos aproximar dos nossos consultores, representantes e consumidores.


Você já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa que se preocupa com a sustentabilidade? Você gosta de criar relações, desenvolver equipe e de gerar boas experiências? Você já se imaginou em um lugar que valoriza a diversidade? Você gosta de perfumes, cosméticos e maquiagem? Se você respondeu sim para todas essas perguntas, estamos procurando VOCÊ!



Isso é a NATURA!


Atualmente temos mais de 1000 lojas abertas em todo Brasil e levamos nossa brasilidade para 9 países! O varejo é um canal que gera experimentação dos diversos produtos e estabelece relações entre a Natura e nossos clientes.


VIVA SUA BELEZA e venha trabalhar conosco! Te convidamos a avaliar essa oportunidade:


Auxiliar de Loja - Shopping Campo Grande | (Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência)


Endereço: Av. Afonso Pena, 4909 - Santa Fé, Campo Grande - MS,


O que estamos buscando?

Procuramos profissionais com conhecimento em produtos e serviços, além de habilidades sólidas em organização e gestão de tarefas, para colaborar com a equipe de loja.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Profissional que será o responsável pela organização do estoque da loja;
  • Fazer a separação de produtos a fim de atender os pedidos captados, de forma rápida e com qualidade (sem falta, danos e/ou excessos);
  • Obedecer todos os regulamentos e procedimentos de trabalho da empresa;
  • Garantir a organização dos produtos nas prateleiras;
  • Limpeza das prateleiras;
  • Apoio no recebimento de materiais diversos;

title: Senior Dotnet Developer
description:
Sonata Software Overview

In today's market, there is a unique duality in technology adoption. On one side, extreme focus on cost containment by clients, and on the other, deep motivation to modernize their Digital storefronts to attract more consumers and B2B customers.

As a leading Modernization Engineering company, we aim to deliver modernization-driven hypergrowth for our clients based on the deep differentiation we have created in Modernization Engineering, powered by our Lightening suite and 16-step Platformation™ playbook. In addition, we bring agility and systems thinking to accelerate time to market for our clients.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has a strong global presence, including key regions in the US, UK, Europe, APAC, and ANZ. We are a trusted partner of world-leading companies in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance), HLS (Healthcare and Lifesciences), TMT (Telecom, Media, and Technology), Retail & CPG, and Manufacturing space. Our bouquet of Modernization Engineering Services cuts across Cloud, Data, Dynamics, Contact Centres, and around newer technologies like Generative AI, MS Fabric, and other modernization platforms.



Job Title - Sr .NET Developer

Location- Brazil (Remote)




Ideal Experience:


  • 8+ years of Development and Production support experience
  • .NET Core 8/C#: Proven ability to read, understand, and debug code written in .NET Core 8 (or a very recent version like .NET 6/7) and C#.
  • Visual Studio Proficiency: Strong familiarity with the Visual Studio IDE for debugging, navigating, and inspecting code.
  • Advanced Observability Tools:
  • New Relic: Proven experience using New Relic APM for application monitoring and proficiency in writing complex NRQL queries.
  • CloudWatch: Expert-level skill in analyzing logs via CloudWatch Logs Insights for diagnostics.
  • Advanced Troubleshooting: Demonstrated experience in applying methodical problem-solving to complex, high-traffic applications.
  • API Testing Tools: Hands-on experience using Postman for testing APIs and simulating payloads.
  • AWS Services: Familiarity with the core Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure:
  • Compute: AWS Lambda and EC2
  • Data & Messaging: SQS, EventBridge, DynamoDB, and S3
  • Networking Fundamentals: Understanding of HTTP/S protocols and common request routing and integration patterns.




Why join Sonata Software?

At Sonata, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build never seen before solutions to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you will not be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Sonata Software is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: JDE Functional Finance Lead
description:
We’re looking for an experienced JDE Functional Finance Lead to join our team and play a key role in supporting and optimizing JD Edwards Financial processes. This role is ideal for a hands-on finance systems professional with strong functional expertise in GL, AP, Tax, and regulatory compliance .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and support JD Edwards (JDE) Financial modules , including GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, and Tax
  • Partner with Finance, Tax, Audit, and IT teams to ensure accurate and compliant financial processes
  • Translate business requirements into functional system solutions
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities
  • Ensure compliance with financial regulations, tax rules, and internal controls
  • Lead testing (UAT), enhancements, and system improvements
  • Provide functional guidance, training, and ongoing support to finance users
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate financial processes


Required Skills and Experience:

  • Strong functional experience with JD Edwards Financials
  • Proven expertise in General Ledger, Accounts Payable, and Tax
  • Solid understanding of financial regulations and compliance
  • Experience leading or supporting JDE implementations or upgrades
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with technical and business teams
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Information Systems
  • Experience in multi-entity or multi-country financial environments
  • Prior experience as a functional lead or subject matter expert

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML)
description:
About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Remote : Contract


The Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML – Pricing) plays a crucial role in the development and deployment of innovative machine learning solutions for retail pricing that includes understanding various customer and operational business constraints and translating complex real-world problems into well-defined mathematical objectives


✅ Minimum Requirements: - PhD or Masters degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operation Research or related field - 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning, 3+ years experience in building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production environments at scale

- Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, feature engineering etc), algorithms/techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization), and experiment design

- Proficiency with scientific libraries in Python (numpy, pandas, polars) and Machine Learning tools and frameworks (ScikitLearn, Tensorflow, Keras, PyTorch)

- Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets

- Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)

- Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure - Fluency in Python, SQL

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
Sobre a Nuvia


A Nuvia é a plataforma de AI-Powered Growth para vendas B2B. No ano passado, fechamos uma rodada com NXTP Ventures, Gilgamesh Ventures, 16|16 Ventures, LASP Capital e o scout fund da a16z e logo depois adquirimos a Datasaga.ai (consultoria de dados e IA para vendas) para acelerar nossa operação.

Não vendemos promessa, entregamos pipeline. Com isso, nossos clientes têm em média, +35% de conversão e -50% no custo de aquisição de clientes.

Agora estamos expandindo o time que vai escalar isso para centenas de empresas (nacionais e internacionais). Se você quer ajudar construir a máquina de vendas do futuro (e não só operar ferramentas) esse é o seu lugar.


Seu Papel


Como RevOps Specialist ou GTM Engineer, você vai ser o motor de execução das campanhas de outbound dos nossos clientes. Não é sobre fazer spam, é sobre construir sistemas que transformam estratégia em pipeline de forma escalável e replicável.

Você vai operar na interseção de dados, automação e vendas. Se você não sabe o que é um waterfall de enriquecimento, se nunca montou uma sequência multicanal do zero, ou se acha que \"automação\" é fazer um Zap básico - essa vaga não é pra você.

O que você vai fazer


  • Construir e operar campanhas multicanal (LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp) do zero ao resultado
  • Criar workflows de automação para enriquecimento, scoring, roteamento e sequenciamento de leads
  • Integrar ferramentas via APIs, webhooks e automações (CRM ↔ outbound ↔ enrichment)
  • Analisar performance e otimizar campanhas com base em métricas reais (reply rate, positive reply, meetings booked, pipeline gerado)
  • Garantir higiene de CRM — dados limpos, pipelines organizados, propriedades padronizadas
  • Otimizar prompts de agentes de Outbound para criação de estratégias e copies.
  • Documentar playbooks para escalar a operação sem depender de você


Quem você é hoje


Você é RevOps Analyst, Growth Engineer, Sales Ops ou GTM Ops em uma startup B2B SaaS com outbound estruturado, agência de outbound/lead gen, ou consultoria HubSpot/Salesforce.

Você já montou campanhas que geraram pipeline de verdade — não só volume. Entende o processo comercial e sabe traduzir isso em fluxos técnicos que rodam sozinhos.

Ou: Você era SDR/BDR e migrou para ops porque percebeu que escala vem de sistemas, não de força bruta. Você automatizou seu próprio trabalho antes de mudar de função.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • 2-4 anos de experiência em RevOps, Sales Ops, Growth Ops ou GTM Ops (B2B SaaS ou agência)
  • N8N avançado - workflows de enriquecimento, roteamento, scoring, integrações. Não só triggers básicos.
  • Python básico - scripts de transformação de dados, chamadas de API, manipulação de listas
  • SQL básico - Queries básicas para análise, extração e limpeza de dados. Você não precisa saber fazer tudo, mas se não souber, precisa explicar muito bem a uma IA como fazer.
  • CRM avançado - workflows, custom properties, APIs, integrações, relatórios. Não \"já usei\". Mas \"já construí\".
  • Experiência real com outbound - já operou campanhas que geraram reuniões qualificadas, não só disparos em massa


Diferenciais que pesam

  • Experiência com Clay (enrichment, waterfalls, AI personalization), Apollo, Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist ou outras ferramentas de automação de Outbound.
  • Já integrou CRMs com ferramentas de outbound via API.
  • Conhecimento de APIs de scraping de dados.
  • Certificações HubSpot, RD, Salesforce ou outras.
  • Background em agência de outbound ou consultoria HubSpot.
  • Já desenvolveu aplicações de Hubspot ou outros CRMs.
  • Inglês ou espanhol intermediário.


O que você NÃO é

  • SDR que quer \"subir de cargo\" mas nunca automatizou nada;
  • Marketeiro que só sabe dar aula mas nunca construiu nada que funcione;
  • Dev que nunca viu um pipeline de vendas de perto;
  • Pessoa que precisa de especificação detalhada pra começar a resolver um problema.


Modelo de contratação e Benefícios

  • Remuneração competitiva com variável AGRESSIVÃO.
  • Benefícios de saúde/alimentação
  • Verba para cursos e formações em Vendas/Automações/AI e todos os assuntos correlatos.
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto ou híbrido (disponibilidade para calls em horário comercial BR)

  • Já integrou CRMs com ferramentas de outbound via API.
  • Conhecimento de APIs de scraping de dados.
  • Certificações HubSpot, RD, Salesforce ou outras.
  • Background em agência de outbound ou consultoria HubSpot.
  • Já desenvolveu aplicações de Hubspot ou outros CRMs.
  • Inglês ou espanhol intermediário.


O que você NÃO é

  • SDR que quer \"subir de cargo\" mas nunca automatizou nada;
  • Marketeiro que só sabe dar aula mas nunca construiu nada que funcione;
  • Dev que nunca viu um pipeline de vendas de perto;
  • Pessoa que precisa de especificação detalhada pra começar a resolver um problema.


Modelo de contratação e Benefícios

  • Remuneração competitiva com variável AGRESSIVÃO.
  • Benefícios de saúde/alimentação
  • Verba para cursos e formações em Vendas/Automações/AI e todos os assuntos correlatos.
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto ou híbrido (disponibilidade para calls em horário comercial BR)

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Consultor SAP Basis


Buscamos um Consultor SAP Basis qualificado e proativo para gerenciar, manter e otimizar sistemas SAP em um cenário RISE com SAP. Esta função exige experiência prática com ambientes SAP hospedados em nuvem, especialmente em plataformas como SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Analytics Cloud e integração com hiperescaladores (AWS, Azure, GCP). O candidato ideal garantirá alta disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança dos aplicativos SAP e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com provedores SAP e de nuvem.


Responsabilidades:


  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a Equipe de Especialistas do Cliente no escritório do cliente.
  • Experiência com HANA (obrigatório)
  • Gerenciar operações técnicas para SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP BW/4HANA.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Operações de Nuvem SAP, provedores de nuvem e equipes de TI do cliente.
  • Apoiar projetos de migração para o RISE com SAP (integração, conversão de sistemas, atividades de migração para a nuvem).
  • Gerencie a administração de usuários, o gerenciamento de transporte, cópias do sistema, backups, restaurações, aplicação de patches e atualizações.
  • Configure e monitore o SAP Cloud ALM, o Solution Manager ou o Focused Run, conforme apropriado para monitoramento centrado na nuvem.
  • Implemente as melhores práticas de segurança SAP, incluindo o fortalecimento do sistema e as autorizações de usuários.
  • Analise o desempenho do sistema e proponha otimizações.
  • Participe do gerenciamento de incidentes e problemas, análise de causa raiz e monitoramento proativo.
  • Gerencie cortes técnicos para implementações ou atualizações do SAP no ambiente RISE.
  • Crie e mantenha documentação técnica, incluindo runbooks operacionais.
  • Mantenha-se atualizado com as inovações SAP (roadmap RISE, serviços SAP BTP, ofertas de hiperescala).


Requisitos:


  • Experiência como Consultor SAP Basis.
  • Experiência com HANA db. (obrigatório)
  • Inglês avançado

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
A Toronto-based agency is seeking intermediate Full-stack developers to join their global technology group. This agency lives at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity to provide clients with high-performing campaigns and digital products that shape connected customer experiences. They've helped their clients implement fully integrated CRM customer journeys, built robust digital experiences, and created national loyalty programs with decades of experience in sectors of automotive, financial, telco and retail.


Responsibilities: Designing and developing user interfaces (UIs): This involves translating design mockups into actual web pages using HTML, CSS, Component Libraries, and React with Typescript. ● Creating responsive and interactive web pages: Ensuring websites look good and function smoothly on all devices (desktops, tablets, and phones).

● Optimizing website performance: Making sure websites load quickly and efficiently.

● Writing server-side code: Using languages like Javascript, Typescript on Node.js to handle data storage, retrieval, and processing.

● Developing APIs (Application Programming Interfaces): Creating interfaces that allow different applications to communicate with each other.

● Managing databases: Designing, implementing, and maintaining databases to store and organize data.

● Testing: Writing and updating Jest unit tests and Cypress E2E tests to ensure strong test-driven development.

● Understanding the entire web development process: Having a holistic view of how the front-end and back-end work together.

● Troubleshooting and debugging issues: Being able to identify and fix problems that may arise in any part of the application.

● Working with different technologies: Being proficient in a variety of programming languages, frameworks, and tools.

● Communicating with Stakeholders: Reporting on progress to agile pod teammates, and clients.

● Creating Unit Tests: Create automated Jest unit tests and ensure appropriate test coverage


Required Skills:

Knowledge of best practices and writing Clean Code

● 3+ years of working knowledge with modern frameworks and languages (REACT & NodeJS)

● Comfortable in the command line (Mac)

● Experience with GraphQL and Apollo

● Can build a prototype and is able to take it to production (kind of mindset)

● You can demonstrate experience from at least one large scale project

● Motivation to learn and be on the forefront of current technology standards and practices

● Ability to rapidly pick up new concepts and technologies

● Familiarity with working with different CMS integrations and building out clean content structures

title: Analista em Power BI Sênior
description:
Objetivo da Posição


Atuar como referência técnica em Power BI , sendo responsável por análises avançadas de dados, modelagem analítica e desenvolvimento de dashboards estratégicos , garantindo confiabilidade, governança e clareza na entrega de insights para apoio à tomada de decisão. O profissional terá papel ativo na liderança técnica de demandas complexas e na orientação do time de dados.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Conduzir análises avançadas de dados , transformando informações em insights estratégicos para o negócio.
  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios em Power BI , com foco em performance, usabilidade e storytelling.
  • Criar e otimizar modelos de dados analíticos , aplicando boas práticas de modelagem e relacionamento.
  • Implementar DAX avançado para cálculos complexos, indicadores e métricas de negócio.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando Power Query (M) e Dataflows .
  • Atuar na otimização de performance de relatórios, modelos e datasets.
  • Realizar integrações com bancos de dados e APIs , garantindo consistência e qualidade das informações.
  • Garantir governança, segurança, parametrização e versionamento no Power BI Service.
  • Apoiar o time como referência técnica , revisando soluções, orientando boas práticas e liderando demandas de maior complexidade.
  • Participar de iniciativas de ETL/ELT , colaborando com times de engenharia e arquitetura de dados.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Domínio avançado de Power BI .
  • Experiência comprovada com:
  • DAX avançado
  • Power Query / M
  • Dataflows
  • Modelagem de dados analíticos
  • Otimização de performance
  • Experiência sólida com SQL , incluindo consultas complexas, joins, CTEs e funções analíticas.
  • Conhecimento em integrações com múltiplas fontes de dados , bancos relacionais e APIs.
  • Vivência com governança, segurança (RLS), parametrização e gestão de ambientes no Power BI Service.
  • Experiência em processos de ETL/ELT .


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimentos em arquitetura de dados e ambientes em nuvem, como:
  • Azure
  • Data Lake
  • Synapse Analytics ou soluções similares.

title: Tibco Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (preferred);
  • 3+ years of experience with TIBCO and in Middleware or system integration environments;
  • Knowledge of TIBCO BusinessWorks version 5 or newer;
  • B2 English is mandatory;
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: 3D Designer - Cinema 4D Specialist (Product, Commercial)
description:
Contractor/Freelance Position | 100% Remote (Full-Time)


We are specifically looking to review portfolios from individuals based in Brazil and Argentina .


About the role

We are seeking a talented Cinema 4D Designer to join our Creative team, specializing in high-fidelity, marketing-grade 3D rendering, imagery, and product animation. This role is responsible for generating stunning, hyper-realistic 3D visuals, clean motion assets, and sophisticated compositing work (photomontages) across our diverse portfolio of brands. This position requires exceptional skill in achieving professional authenticity and meticulous attention to detail. You will collaborate closely with Graphic Designers and other team members to translate creative concepts into precise, high-quality visuals, ensuring consistent and professional execution for all our business-focused content.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop high-end, hyper-realistic product and lifestyle scenes, including advanced image compositing (photomontages), from various reference materials.
  • Create professional 3D product animations (e.g., product rotations, camera moves, and simple showcases).
  • Help us set new standards for the modeling, texturing, lighting of our products, with an absolute dedication to visual authenticity.
  • Accurately translate design concepts into detailed 3D models.
  • Develop high-resolution final images and video assets of rendered content.
  • Successfully balance and prioritise multiple projects simultaneously to meet deadlines.
  • Work with varied project briefs, cooperate with Graphic Designers, and support the wider Creative team.
  • Ensure adherence to brand guidelines, adapting to the distinct visual approaches required for our various brands.
  • Uphold design standards, including consistent file-naming structures and meticulous folder organisation.


Requirements

  • Mandatory: Expert proficiency in Cinema 4D. Please note that this is a strict requirement; we are not seeking users of Blender, 3ds Max, or Maya for this role. Experience with Octane Render is highly preferred.
  • You possess a strong portfolio that showcases expertise in high-definition, commercial-style 3D visualizations, expert image compositing, and 3D animation. Portfolios focused only on character design, game assets, or abstract/fantasy scenes are not suitable for this role.
  • Mandatory: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required. You must be able to fluently communicate and clearly articulate technical 3D constraints to non-technical team members.
  • You have 4+ years’ experience as a 3D designer. Ideally, you’ll have worked in a graphic/animation studio, advertising agency, or an in-house creative department and have some experience working with beauty or wellness products.
  • You possess a proactive interest in emerging 3D technologies and have a willingness to explore AI-powered tools to optimize workflows and push creative boundaries.
  • You are capable of assessing a brief and determining the most effective execution strategy - knowing when to push for technical excellence and when to utilise smart shortcuts to meet tight turnarounds.
  • You are educated to degree level in Design or a related subject (e.g., Graphic Design, Product Design, Animation, or Motion Design).
  • You are proficient in modeling and texturing, and can create stunning, life-like visual assets of packaging, single products, and detailed marketing scenes. Your output must demonstrate strict adherence to photographic quality and detail.
  • You have expertise in lighting set-up, colour, and shading, with a keen focus on optimal product presentation to achieve visual authenticity.
  • You have a superb sense of composition, visual veracity (truthfulness), texture, and illumination, and a sophisticated understanding of materials. You can view products from a customer's perspective.
  • You are highly skilled with Adobe Photoshop (essential for compositing/photomontages) and knowledgeable about the broader Adobe Creative Suite.
  • You can effectively plan, prioritise, and problem-solve in a fast-paced environment, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


To apply:

Please submit your CV and portfolio. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

This position requires exceptional skill in achieving professional authenticity and meticulous attention to detail. You will collaborate closely with Graphic Designers and other team members to translate creative concepts into precise, high-quality visuals, ensuring consistent and professional execution for all our business-focused content.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop high-end, hyper-realistic product and lifestyle scenes, including advanced image compositing (photomontages), from various reference materials.
  • Create professional 3D product animations (e.g., product rotations, camera moves, and simple showcases).
  • Help us set new standards for the modeling, texturing, lighting of our products, with an absolute dedication to visual authenticity.
  • Accurately translate design concepts into detailed 3D models.
  • Develop high-resolution final images and video assets of rendered content.
  • Successfully balance and prioritise multiple projects simultaneously to meet deadlines.
  • Work with varied project briefs, cooperate with Graphic Designers, and support the wider Creative team.
  • Ensure adherence to brand guidelines, adapting to the distinct visual approaches required for our various brands.
  • Uphold design standards, including consistent file-naming structures and meticulous folder organisation.


Requirements

  • Mandatory: Expert proficiency in Cinema 4D. Please note that this is a strict requirement; we are not seeking users of Blender, 3ds Max, or Maya for this role. Experience with Octane Render is highly preferred.
  • You possess a strong portfolio that showcases expertise in high-definition, commercial-style 3D visualizations, expert image compositing, and 3D animation. Portfolios focused only on character design, game assets, or abstract/fantasy scenes are not suitable for this role.
  • Mandatory: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required. You must be able to fluently communicate and clearly articulate technical 3D constraints to non-technical team members.
  • You have 4+ years’ experience as a 3D designer. Ideally, you’ll have worked in a graphic/animation studio, advertising agency, or an in-house creative department and have some experience working with beauty or wellness products.
  • You possess a proactive interest in emerging 3D technologies and have a willingness to explore AI-powered tools to optimize workflows and push creative boundaries.
  • You are capable of assessing a brief and determining the most effective execution strategy - knowing when to push for technical excellence and when to utilise smart shortcuts to meet tight turnarounds.
  • You are educated to degree level in Design or a related subject (e.g., Graphic Design, Product Design, Animation, or Motion Design).
  • You are proficient in modeling and texturing, and can create stunning, life-like visual assets of packaging, single products, and detailed marketing scenes. Your output must demonstrate strict adherence to photographic quality and detail.
  • You have expertise in lighting set-up, colour, and shading, with a keen focus on optimal product presentation to achieve visual authenticity.
  • You have a superb sense of composition, visual veracity (truthfulness), texture, and illumination, and a sophisticated understanding of materials. You can view products from a customer's perspective.
  • You are highly skilled with Adobe Photoshop (essential for compositing/photomontages) and knowledgeable about the broader Adobe Creative Suite.
  • You can effectively plan, prioritise, and problem-solve in a fast-paced environment, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


To apply:

Please submit your CV and portfolio. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: Clinical Trainer LATAM
description:
About Lumenis

Lumenis is a world leader in laser- and light-based technologies for medical and aesthetic applications. Ever since introducing the first medical laser system in the world nearly 45 years ago, Lumenis has been at the forefront of technological innovation and market leadership in its segment. Today, Lumenis offers a wide range of products, an unparalleled technical support system, the largest global installed-base of medical laser products and one of the largest investments in research and development in the industry. Lumenis has installed more than 60,000 medical systems in doctors’ offices, clinics and operating rooms in more than 75 countries around the world. The company has over 100 FDA clearances; more than 250 registered patents & patent applications; and a team of 900 employees that work in synergy worldwide. Further, Lumenis is a truly an international organization, with direct business offices in strategic locations around the world, including the United States, UK, Germany, Israel, China, Hong Kong, India, Japan and Australia.


About the role:

As a Clinical trainer, reporting to the Clinical Training Director, you will be responsible for the development and deployment of clinical training for Lumenis customers, distributors and field employees. This position also involves overseeing every detail of training logistics to guarantee smooth and successful training sessions.


Main Duties:

  • Collaborate closely with the Clinical Training Director to implement and uphold rigorous high quality standards in training
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential customers (digital and onsite).
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential distributors’-affiliated clinical trainers and follow-them up
  • Coordinate all local clinical events.
  • Demonstrate use/ benefits of Lumenis products to the customers.
  • Proactive involvement with the new changing needs of digital engagement.
  • Ensure that all training programs meet the required regulations and standards.
  • Innovate the current educational offering for salesforce and customers to a digital platform.
  • contribute to the global effort in producing collaterals such as but not limited to blog, newsletter, application notes etc


Required Qualifications:

  • Experience or training in the medical device industry; preferable experience in the aesthetics field - an advantage.
  • Experience in preparing and adjusting clinical presentations as per audience and allocated time.
  • Accurate in delivering training messaging.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Must be willing to travel throughout LATAM region – around 70%. and exceptionally outer LATAM
  • Interpersonal skills and professional demeanor.
  • Results- driven and self-motivated.
  • Highly organized and detail oriented.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Cooperate with others, teamwork.
  • Enthusiastic about gaining new knowledge and dedicated to self-improvement by regular engagement in professional development activities (such as but not limited to gathering clinical updates from scientific journals)
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English. Knowledge of Spanish and/or Portuguese will be considered an advantage

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer with a strong experience implementing apps with the languages and frameworks created by Apple for iOS and Google for Android.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • 5+ years experience on native mobile development across both platforms: iOS and Android
  • iOS development with SwiftUI
  • Android development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.

title: EOS Linux Server Manager (Inglês Avançado)
description:
LINUX SERVER MANAGER FOR ENHANCED OPERATIONS SERVICE


We are looking for professionals with extensive experience in Linux and Unix, and public Cloud, for support in Professional Services.

The ideal candidate has deep understanding of Cloud operations, being able to give L3 support, acting in a big team, dedicated to help clients. We need someone able to solve critical and high-impact issues independently.

A customer first mindset is a must.


• Participate in Major incident handling, troubleshoot service request failures, downtime extensions, long running ongoing incidents for a customer. (Level 3 support)

• Quick responses during escalations, take proactive steps to avoid escalations, identifying and driving initiatives to improve the operation and stability for our customer system

• Drive initiatives to standardize and simplify server operations.

• Continuous improvement methodologies: root cause analysis for Service requests failures/outages, performance issues

• Analyze root-causes of the failures (if known) in achieving the KPIS and define a corrective action plan, with well-defined mitigation steps.

• Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams, collaborating with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.

• Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities

• Streamline standard operating procedures by focusing on automation enhancements.

• Proactive Operation services for the customer and service on-demand with timely alert reduction program to all the stakeholders involving the customer.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Technically skilled in providing expert support for all Linux OS/Windows and Infra customer issues (Expert Linux Administrator).

• Strong experience in administration of our cloud platform based on Linux operating systems in Azure, AWS and Google Cloud as well as in SAP data centres.

• Pacemaker administration knowledge.

• Practical experience with OS operation, upgrades and security patching

• Networking experience with the suite of TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, firewalls

• Experience with network services like DNS and LDAP and HTTP proxies

• Good understanding of IT security, OS hardening

• Experience in script programming (Shell, Perl, Python, Go) and with server automation tools (Ansible, CHEF)

• Experience with server operations in large environments and in public clouds.

• Experience in Problem Management, Root cause analysis methodologies

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of related professional experience

• Bachelor’s degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management)

• Good analytical and solution-oriented thinking

• Very good communication

• Experience of safeguarding customer relationship and strong customer service focus

• Fluency in English



We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.
